title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S03 E03 — Nowhere Left to Run
In Virginia Beach, a woman finds herself in jail after neighbors called the police because of her rowdy BBQ; in Mesa, a woman involved in a fender bender is arrested after police on scene discover she had an outstanding warrant.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S03 E04 — Sneezing on Grandma
Officers nab an enraged man for drug possession after a company Christmas party; in Flagler County, deputies arrest a father of three for allegedly sneezing on a store employee, while a street preacher is caught after burglarizing a local beach bar.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S03 E05 — Drunken Duo
In Mesa, a young first-timer is brought into jail following a tense standoff with police during a routine traffic stop; in Virginia Beach, a drunken duo struggles through the booking process after a series of clashes with the deputies.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S03 E06 — Locked Up Love Birds
A career offender is arrested on an outstanding warrant; a couple is brought in on DUI and public intoxication charges; a homeless man with a big attitude is arrested for petit theft while a first-timer turns herself in to complete a 10-day sentence.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S03 E07 — Tased and Confused
A guy attempts to evade police by fleeing on foot; a man is arrested for public urination, while a young mom is brought in for driving without a license or insurance; a young woman faces a hefty jail sentence after violating her probation.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S03 E08 — Down in Flames
In Hancock County, a raging forest fire endangers the facility, sending jail staff into a logistical panic; in Virginia Beach, an exotic dancer lands in jail after leading officers on a 30-minute car chase while intoxicated.

title: Booked: First Day In
description:
S03 E09 — Baller Baby Daddy
In Virginia Beach, an addict and her fiancé are brought in on drug charges; in Modesto, a man is arrested for driving his wife's car after she reported it stolen; in Flagler County, a father is arrested for not paying child support payments.

title: Court Cam
description:
S07 E21 — Episode 21
The mother of a murdered councilwoman throws a bottle at her daughter's accused killer; a defendant attempts to flirt with the judge but still has his bond revoked; the father of a murdered woman forgives her killer - his son-in-law.

title: Court Cam
description:
S07 E20 — Episode 20
The mother of a man on trial for murder gets caught taking a picture of the jury; a defendant is held in contempt of court after flipping off the judge, twice; a judge chastises a disgraced estate attorney and more.

title: Court Cam
description:
S07 E19 — Episode 19
The brothers of a woman murdered by her daughter confront the defendant, their niece, in court; an annoyed defendant walks out of a virtual hearing; a man convicted of manslaughter refuses to look at the grieving grandmother of his victim.

title: Court Cam
description:
S07 E18 — Episode 18
Two disgraced fishing champions apologize for cheating; grieving parents confront the former police officer who killed their son; a man suspected of driving with a suspended license appears in virtual court from a car.

title: Court Cam
description:
S07 E15 — Episode 15
A judge chastises a defendant for his courtroom outburst; a convicted murderer's mother tells the court that she used methamphetamine with him the day he shot his boss; a defendant threatens to sue the judge after an unfavorable decision.

title: Court Cam
description:
S07 E14 — Episode 14
A grieving father stares down the man who killed his daughter; a judge mutes an unruly defendant during a virtual hearing; an arsonist pleads guilty to a decades-old crime.

title: Court Cam
description:
S07 E12 — Episode 12
A defendant claims the pants he was wearing and the drug paraphernalia inside them weren't his; a grieving wife describes the DUI accident that killed her husband; an accused murderer is not happy with his lawyer.

title: Court Cam
description:
S07 E09 — Episode 9
A judge chastises a defendant for sleeping in virtual court; a grieving mother forgives the man who killed her unborn twins; a judge gets creative when sentencing a defendant.

title: Court Cam
description:
Top Five: Courtroom Confrontations 2
A look at some of the wildest courtroom confrontations; a deadly drunken driver is berated by the partner of one of her victims; an inmate attacks another inmate in front of the judge; sexual assault victims confront their attacker.

title: Court Cam
description:
Top Five: Acts of Mercy 2
Merciful courtroom moments include a father who forgives the woman responsible for his son's death, a woman who offers kind words to the person who attacked her, and a mother who refuses to hate the driver whose accident killed her teenage daughter.

title: Court Cam
description:
S04 E20 — Episode 20

title: Court Cam
description:
S04 E15 — Episode 15
A demonic-looking defendant sends a threatening message to a jury; a courtroom officer goes too far; a judge receives a severe sentence for her crimes, proving she's not above the law.

description:
